jobs.description:
Requirements

Daily to-do list will include:

building high-quality reusable code,

developing functional and sustainable applications,

constantly striving to optimise performance and debugging,

being involved and participating in the overall application lifecycle,

defining and communicating technical and design requirements,

constantly learning and trying new technologies.

Our Technology Stack

Java and Kotlin,

Spring Boot,

Maven,

Git, GitLab,

Continuous integration tools (Jenkins, TeamCity …),

Profilers (YourKit …),

OpenEHR.

Skills You Need To Excel At This Job

experience in Java,

passion for learning, growth, and complex challenges,

teamwork and collaboration skills,

English language.

Responsibilities

While we currently don’t have specific job positions available, we are nevertheless actively expanding our back-end talent pool for future opportunities.

Our back-end developers are working with our team of developers, designers, DevOps, analysts, and QA testers. The job involves a lot of coding, debugging, problem-solving, code reviewing, trying new technologies, and staying up to date with current best practices.
Show less
